scoring_justification: Agent submits only the aggregated CSV; recompute from raw Monte Carlo trajectory is infeasible. Compare reported ratios to the paper's Table 3 values with 20% relative tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold surface molar ratios from Table 3 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 3 in Barone & Duca, J. Catal. 2002
hidden_assets.generation_method: copied directly from the published table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the actual reported simulation results from the paper's tdMC algorithm

theta_FFC_over_HFC.description: ratio of free‑flag to hindered‑flag 2,4DNT surface molar ratio

theta_FFC_plus_HFC.description: total fraction of surface covered by flag 2,4DNT (FFC+HFC)

outputs.description: Surface molar ratio parameters for 2,4‑dinitro‑toluene at four metal dispersion values, both in the absence and presence of hydrogenation.

output_contract.notes: The agent must re‑implement the tdMC algorithm based on the method description; no external code package beyond a standard programming language and numerical libraries is required. The event probabilities and hitting configuration probabilities are provided as fixed constants in the instruction. The verifier compares each row's computed ratios against hidden reference values (from Table 3 of the paper) using a relative tolerance.
